theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Communication Svcs (+1.60%) and Consumer Staples (+1.48%) led the market today, while Energy (-1.80%) and Utilities (-1.57%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged +0.46%, defensives +0.15%, and value/cyclicals -0.48% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -0.14%, Dow +0.29%, Nasdaq -0.40% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps bucked the broader trend, with the Russell 2000 up +0.26%, outperforming large caps. The VIX rose 4.68% to 19.44, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold slipped 0.38% to $4,076.80, crude oil was little changed at $82.87, and bitcoin slipped 0.59% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
